title: Differentiation of the radial cutoff mass under the integral sign (step 5)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N (Borel σ-algebra) and y ∈ ℝ^N. Let h : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous, and let φ : ℝ → ℝ be of class C¹ with φ(s) = 0 for every s ≥ A², where A > 0. Let R ∈ ℝ with μ(B_R(y)) < ∞, where B_R(y) = closedBall y R. Then for every t₀ > 0 with t₀·A < R, the function t ↦ ∫ φ(|z − y|²/t²)·h(z) dμ(z) (Bochner integral) has derivative ∫ φ'(|z − y|²/t₀²)·(−2|z − y|²/t₀³)·h(z) dμ(z) at t₀, where φ' := deriv φ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (y : Euclidean N) (h : Euclidean N → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (A R t₀ : ℝ), Continuous h → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 0 < A → (∀ s, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0) → μ (closedBall y R) ≠ ∞ → 0 < t₀ → t₀ * A < R → HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ ∫ z, φ (‖z - y‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) * h z ∂μ) (∫ z, deriv φ (‖z - y‖ ^ 2 / t₀ ^ 2) * (-2 * ‖z - y‖ ^ 2 / t₀ ^ 3) * h z ∂μ) t₀
